subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to transition a work item's state (open ↔ closed, with an optional reason), the tracker shall apply the transition idempotently, such that repeating an already-applied transition is a recorded no-op, not an error.
rationale: lifecycle must be raceable and re-runnable (INV-8/AP-22)
fit_criterion: closing a closed item returns success + no-op; state and reason persist
